c. 1949 December
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed notes by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
DOGMA OF ASSUMPTION DIVINELY OPPORTUNE
TO SAVE, HOPE IN THE SUPERNATURAL: AND THE SOULS OF BILLIONS.
TO RESCUE FROM DESPAIR HOPE IN THE SUPERNATURAL: AND THE SOULS OF BILLIONS.
Blessed be God in all His designs. Blessed be Jesus Christ in His appreciative love, in His filial gratitude to Mary our heavenly Mother (Mary) -- Jesus' Own Mother because she gave him his human nature and stood-by Him to the end: our dear, heavenly Mother, because she has given Jesus Himself to us, human and divine, -- Our Way, our Truth, our Life; and next to Him, whatever our falls, our never failing -- to the end our Refuge of sinners. But if, "Among men, gratitude for favors received is the very first and the surest indication of intelligence", and again, if Jusus is both divienly intelligent and infinitely appreciative and grateful; and furthermore, if in so many other regards, Mary His Mother was so singularly favored, if on accout of her singular destiny to be- come the Mother of God she was divinely preserved from every taint of original or other sin, receiving instead such all-surpassing, till-then-undreamed-of graces that even at such a distance her peerless Excellency PERceptibly heightened the triumph of every phase of heavenly glory, if Jesus as God had a hand in preparing her a worthy abode for Himself - - His living Tabernacle for nine months -- surpassing all conception but divine, if He endowed her with a will, a memory, an understanding outstandingly similar to His own, if for thirty years as a single pupil
if then after fifteen years of most perfect correspondence with every grace received, with seraphic longing and pleading for the hastening of the Messiah -- the Saviour's coming -- her hopes continually growing that it might be her great privilege to know that the Massiah were come and possibly that some way or other she herself might have the happy privilege of serving the to-be Virgin -Mother, if after fifteen years of such fidelity, such prophetic hope, such seraphic charity -- never dreaming that she herself was already the chosen one -- she received the joyous surprise of her life. God's chosen messenger most reverently greets her: "Hail full of grace!
(unfinished draft)
